projectContext.title: TIM — Theoretically Infinite Memory | Active | Local-first project memory | TypeScript, SQLite, MCP
projectContext.overview:
## Project overview
TIM is a local-first memory service for AI agents working across projects and sessions. SQLite stores project knowledge, work items, recorded exchanges and derived summaries. MCP exposes agent tools; the CLI provides setup, diagnostics, migration and recovery. Optional synchronization and model-driven summarization are separate operational components.

Eleven packages: tim-core, tim-store, tim-mcp, tim-cli, tim-hooks, tim-summarizer, tim-migrate, tim-sync-client, tim-sync-server, tim-skills, tim-quality-benchmark.
